body.name: At-most-one-informative-hazard local audit criterion
body.construction:
For \(S_t=\varnothing\) when \(t\ne k\) and
\(S_k\subseteq\{k-1,k,k+1\}\cap\{1,\ldots,T\}\), define
\[
\mathsf C_{1,\mathrm{loc}}(T,k,S_k,B,(|\mathcal X_t|)_{t=1}^T)=1
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
J_+(S_k)=\varnothing
\ \text{or}\ 
\mathcal H_\star(B)\ne\varnothing.
\]
When \(J_+(S_k)\ne\varnothing\), \(j_\star=\max J_+(S_k)\) and
\[
\mathcal H_\star(B)=
\{(d,\ell):0\le d<k,\ j_\star\le\ell\le T,\ \ell\in B_d\}.
\]
Thus the criterion is a graph-and-pattern incidence rule and does not refer to \(\operatorname{GID}\).
